You think you know yourself? Try again... 😊
It's amazing how much your body holds informations even if you try to hide it. Someone experienced like Irina can read your subconscious mind and detangles it for your to understand and know where to start to heal yourself.
If you are curious to know yourself on a deeper level. She is the one you need.
Her way of approaching things in a ludic way makes it even more stimulating for your mind.
She is an exceptional human being.
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Thank you, Irina, for your attentive listening and your valuable advice, which allowed me to find myself and understand myself much better. I wish other people could, especially men, have the chance to experience therapy with you.
Warm regards,
Denis

My art therapy session with Irina Pavlova profoundly transformed my life. I sought her help during a challenging period when I stood at a crossroads, faced with a life-altering decision for myself and my family. I was lost in illusions, but Irina gently guided me to see reality, supporting me throughout the process. Thanks to our encounter, my journey to self-discovery began. I wholeheartedly recommend her expertise to anyone in need.

I am nearly 50 years old and was always hesitant about psychologists.

Talking with Irina has helped me immensely, her mind is incredibly sharp and I would be in a very different position without her assistance 🙏🏻 …

I did the "I cope" program with Irina.
Irina is very professional and has the ability to "see through you" and guide you with her very smart ideas.
The minute I entered the studio she gave me a confident and free feeling.

It’s my best experience with psychologists. I
have an years of therapy before. I’m so happy to find this way of help to myself. I have got result, feel more calm, more relax. Thank you so much for support in my difficult time. Now I’m more confident, know for I can help myself daily 🙏🏻♥️ …
